user.title: Add Video Status Monitor
user.description: Configure a camera to monitor for visual state changes.

data_description.rtsp_url: Full RTSP URL of the camera stream, e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.100:554/stream
data_description.states: Comma-separated list of visual states to detect, e.g. open,closed,partial
data_description.scan_interval: How often to capture and analyse a frame (seconds)
